statistic.estimand: W(X3) - W(PROSPX consensus), within (frame, side, year) Spearman, size-weighted, keep_lv, groups of 20 or more

x3_weights.note: ridge slopes are per standard deviation of the z-scored feature on the stage's scale (R: log odds of reaching; T: seasons of 600 PA or 700 BF; Q: WAR per such season); a slope of 0 means the penalty removed it
